note: A leaderboard table's rho reference was measured at a commit.  When the strong-rho implementation changes after that, the table's x reference describes a rho that is no longer the standing one.  scripts/ic_audit/check_reference_currency.sh fails when a table's rho source files are not the version (git blob) an entry here has assessed, so each change of the standing rho needs either a re-measurement or a dated, measured assessment of its effect on the table.

A.assessment: Rule v3 priced rho as built (32 lanes). 13 commits changed the standing strong rho afterwards; research/ecbench_rho_optimized_20261014 measured the largest, 0.8046x solve instructions (a 1.25x faster rho), so Table A's x reference is against a slower rho than the standing one. The step-cost gap to the canonical step is in research/validation_sweep_20261019/A-leaderboard/raw/recompute_A_haiku.json (xref_canonical_step); the lane sweep in research/leaderboard_rigor_20261021/rho_lanes/ shows it is not a lane-count effect. No re-measurement of Table A at the current rho exists yet.

C.assessment: Table C's rho S is S20's (2026-09-26) batch rho priced at the canonical step. The standing strong rho has changed since (see Table A); S20's counts were re-verified equal at n = 41 only. No re-measurement of Table C's reference at the current rho exists yet.
